text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios slays her debut, yaay! 
...But it's over way too fast, giving her 
major sad vibes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies, 
chosen purely for how cool the name 
sounds. Taking on a GⅠ right away, but 
zero pressure! If anything, running in 
such a crazy big race totally hypes her 
up.
